definitions: To view something with skepticism or to not believe it entirely.
To accept something as true only with reservations or qualifications.
examples: You should take his promises with a grain of salt.
I take everything she says with a grain of salt.
Take that rumor with a grain of salt; it's probably not true.
lemma: to take with a grain of salt
synonyms: to take with a pinch of salt
source: to take with a grain of salt
